data.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Hanna (AT3), advisory 30/1450Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA BECOMES A REMNANT LOW PRESSURE AREA. As of 3:00 PM GMT Wed Sep 30 the center of Hanna was located near 33.4, -43.6 with movement E at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1008 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Nineteen-E (EP4), advisory 01/0231Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: DEPRESSION BARELY A TROPICAL CYCLONE. As of 8:00 PM PDT Wed Sep 30 the center of Nineteen-E was located near 15.2, -125.9 with movement ENE at 14 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 30 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Rachel (EP3), advisory 01/0235Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL GRADUALLY STRENGTHENING AS IT CONTINUES NORTHWESTWARD. As of 8:00 PM MST Wed Sep 30 the center of Rachel was located near 19.2, -108.5 with movement NW at 7 mph. The minimum central pressure was 975 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 90 mph.
